stories.title: Mold Town Council seeks contractor for five-year Christmas lighting deal
stories.summary: Mold Town Council could spend up to £151,200 over the next five years on its Christmas lighting scheme. The council has put the contract out to tender, covering installation, maintenance, removal and secure storage of its Christmas lights in Mold town centre. The initial contract will run for five years, covering the 2026 to 2030

stories.summary: The owner of Bryn Sion Farm near Afonwen has appealed against Flintshire County Council’s refusal of plans to convert a farm outbuilding into a holiday let, and is seeking to have his costs paid by the council. stories.title: Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru begins another review of Senedd constituencies
stories.summary: A review of the Senedd constituencies covering Flintshire has been launched by the body responsible for setting Wales’s political boundaries. The Democracy and Boundary Commission Cymru published its Guide to the 2030 Review on Wednesday. The current Fflint Wrecsam and Clwyd constituencies, which between them cover Flintshire, were created ahead of this year’s Senedd election
